readme.run: Remove Gibbs ringing from every slice and write the derivatives
notes: The .bval, .bvec and .json beside the image with the same name are passed
through under the output's name; --bval, --bvec and --json name others.
The sidecar's SliceEncodingDirection sets the in-plane axes; --axes overrides it.
No network connection is required. Input is NIfTI only: convert DICOM with
dcm2niix first, or use the web app.
Cite Kellner E, Dhital B, Kiselev VG, Reisert M. Gibbs-ringing artifact
removal based on local subvoxel-shifts. Magn Reson Med 2016;76:1574-1581,
and MRtrix3: Tournier JD et al. NeuroImage 2019;202:116137.
